order: Display groups from published subtype annotations; within-group source subtype order. Participants sorted by median change across the selected myeloid subtypes within each cohort; ties broken by participant ID.
statistics: Paired year-2 minus baseline score; linear sample quartiles and median; proportion of complete paired differences strictly below zero. No confidence intervals or significance tests.

marks.participant_outline_policy: Opaque borderless filled circles. A 1.6 pt hollow circle with 0.4 pt outline was physically tested first; dense near-ties cannot all fit within the compact facet lanes.
marks.summary_policy: Compact unfilled Q1–Q3 box with a dark median tick; IQR is participant spread, not a confidence interval. Ledger summaries occupy a separate strip below the participant dots in each row.

palette_status: Blue #55A0FB and coral #FF8080 are rounded 8-bit vector stroke colors observed in scWAT.pdf page 4, Figure 2 (DOI 10.1038/s41467-023-43021-8). Reassignment to Petrus/Kerr and to the zero-centered matrix is an explicit EasyViz design adaptation; the source paper's biological labels and statistics are not transferred.

style_sources.observed: Bright blue/coral marks, opaque points, compact thin outlined summaries, restrained black axes.
style_sources.adopted: Vector-observed cohort colors; thin black axes and zero guide; compact unfilled IQR summaries.

style_sources.observed: Small hollow participant circles, compact repeated categories, purposeful thin black guides.
style_sources.adopted: Compact aligned cohort facets and crisp point treatment. Hollow circles were evaluated, then replaced by smaller opaque filled circles to preserve separate marks in the denser Kerr rows.

selection: All 16 Myeloid_* source columns, all matched subjects at the requested time points.
